filters.name: chargeback_ratio_filter
filters.rationale: Regulatory threshold is 1.02%; values outside this range are invalid and must be flagged

filters.name: decline_rate_bin_range_filter
filters.condition: all elements in array between 0 and 100 inclusive
filters.rationale: Decline rates are bounded by 0–100%; any out-of-range value is invalid

filters.name: reserve_balance_filter
filters.rationale: Negative reserve balances are not permitted; must be flagged if present

clamps.name: clamp_chargeback_ratio_to_threshold
clamps.rationale: Regulatory scheme threshold is 1.02%; any value above must be clamped to this limit

clamps.name: clamp_decline_rate_to_max
clamps.rationale: Decline rates cannot exceed 100%; clamping ensures compliance with scheme rules

clamps.name: clamp_reserve_balance_to_floor
clamps.rationale: Reserve balances cannot be negative; floor at zero enforced by rule

normalizations.name: normalize_chargeback_ratio_to_percent
normalizations.rationale: All chargeback ratios are required in percentage units; basis points must be explicitly labeled and converted

normalizations.name: normalize_decline_rate_bins_to_percent
normalizations.rationale: Decline rates are expressed in percentage units; basis points must be converted and labeled

interpolations.name: interpolate_missing_reserve_balance
interpolations.rationale: When reserve balance is missing, interpolate from adjacent bin values to maintain continuity; only if both sides exist

unit_discipline_enforcement: Every numeric column must carry its unit in the label; e.g., 'chargeback_ratio_pct' not 'chargeback_ratio'.
No column may contain a value without an explicit unit label.
Basis-point values (e.g., 50 bps) are never stored as percentages or floats without a unit label such as 'bps'.

total_chargeback_ratio_vs_component_sum.description: The sum of chargeback ratios across all segments must equal the total chargeback ratio in the portfolio
total_chargeback_ratio_vs_component_sum.rationale: Regulators require recomputability from raw data; any discrepancy must be flagged as a hard error

decline_rate_bins_sum_invariant.description: The sum of decline rate bin ranges across all segments must equal the total decline rate in portfolio
decline_rate_bins_sum_invariant.rationale: Total decline rate is derived from bin ranges; any deviation indicates a transformation error

reserve_balance_floor_invariant.description: All reserve balances must be greater than or equal to the required floor value (0 USD)
reserve_balance_floor_invariant.rationale: Reserve balances cannot go below zero; violation is a hard error per appetite paragraph 6.1

holiday_projection_sum_invariant.description: The sum of holiday season projections across segments must equal the total projected exposure
holiday_projection_sum_invariant.rationale: Total projection is derived from segment-level values; any mismatch must be flagged as a hard error

reconciliation_rules: All component-level totals and their aggregate sums are reconciled at the portfolio level.
Any discrepancy between sum of components and total is treated as a hard error, not a rounding issue.

validation_checkpoints.action: validate all fields exist and match variant definitions
verify invariants hold true for each segment and portfolio-level totals

notes: This specification is scoped strictly to the quarterly settlement extracts as supplied. It does not include support for external data sources, stress testing, or forward-looking modeling. All decisions are based on the provided material and governed by appetite paragraphs referenced in the rules section. Any input that fails field matching triggers a halt with diagnostic message; no silent drops or guesses are permitted.
